The formalized counterexample is the compact set of rank-one orthogonal projectors onto lines in $\mathbb R^4$, with the Frobenius metric. It lies in the nine-dimensional affine space of trace-one symmetric matrices, has diameter $\sqrt2$, and cannot be covered by ten arbitrary sets of smaller diameter.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
